run_no_skip() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  local log="${OUTPUT}/${name}.log"
  "$@" 2>&1 | tee "${log}"
  if grep -E -- '(^|[[:space:]])(SKIP|skipped)(:|[[:space:]])|--- SKIP:' "${log}" >/dev/null; then
    fail "${name} reported a skipped proof"
